title: Gully Cricket Ke Ajeeb Niyam
sources: Desi Gully Cricket Lore & Street Rules

lines.text: Gully cricket ka sabse bada niyam: jiski bat, pehli batting wahi karega!
Aur agar ball Sharma aunty ke ghar gayi... toh batsman seedha OUT!
lines.caps: Ball Sharma aunty | ke ghar gayi... | *OUT!

lines.text: Mohalle ka fast bowler aaya, aakhon mein aag, aur phenki tez raftaar bouncer!
Batsman ne ball ko dekha, pairo ko jamaya, aur bat ko ghumaya...
Boom! Aisa helicopter shot mara ki ball seedhi chaand par!
Phatak! Sharma aunty ki khidki ka kaanch chaknachoor!
Sab bhaag gaye, lekin batsman bola: Six toh six hota hai bro!
